title: Quick Korean Roe Skillet
description: A fresh, low-carb solo dinner featuring chewy Korean roe marinated in miso and pan‑seared to gooey perfection. It cooks in under 10 minutes and is perfect for one person.
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together miso paste, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, gochujang (if using), and minced garlic until smooth.
Gently fold the fresh roe into the miso mixture, letting it marinate for 2 minutes while you heat the skillet.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and add 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, swirling to coat.
When the oil shimmers, pour the marinated roe mixture into the skillet, spreading it evenly.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, pressing down lightly with a spatula to form a thin, golden crust.
Flip the roe layer and cook for an additional 1 minute, until the other side is lightly browned and the roe is set but still gooey.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the skillet and let them toast for 30 seconds.
Remove from heat, garnish with chopped green onion, and serve immediately.
